data.title: The Right Size
data.description: Build the part that turns spinning into up-and-down, and pick sizes that make the working end go just far enough.

challenges.name: Pump jack
challenges.intro: This machine pumps heavy crude oil up from deep underground wells.
challenges.instruction: The Pump jack's shaft only spins, but its pump has to go up and down. Build the missing part that turns spinning into up-and-down: one part on the shaft and one part to the slider, then run the machine.

stages.job: Spins quickly using electricity to provide power.
Carries the spinning motion smoothly over to the gears.
Slows down the spinning speed to give the machine huge lifting strength.
Uses a spinning crank and heavy metal rod to push and pull.
Rocks up and down like a seesaw to pull the oil up.
Sucks oil out of the ground with each upward stroke.

challenges.principle: A motor turns a crank around and around to push and pull on one end of a giant beam. The beam rocks up and down like a seesaw to lift oil out of the ground.

challenges.name: Windmill water pump
challenges.intro: This machine uses the wind to pump fresh water out of underground wells.
challenges.instruction: The Windmill water pump's shaft only spins, but its pump has to go up and down. Build the missing part that turns spinning into up-and-down: one part on the shaft and one part to the slider, then run the machine.

stages.job: Catches the breeze and spins around in the air.
Slows the spin down to create stronger pushing power.
Turns the round-and-round spin into an up-and-down push and pull with a crank and rod.
Draws fresh water up from deep inside the ground.

challenges.principle: As the wind spins the big wheel, a crank changes that spinning into a straight up-and-down motion. This moves a long pump up and down inside the well pipe.

challenges.name: Air compressor
challenges.intro: This machine pumps air into a strong metal tank to power tools in a garage.
challenges.instruction: The Air compressor's shaft only spins, but its pump has to go up and down. Build the missing part that turns spinning into up-and-down: one part on the shaft and one part to the slider, then run the machine.

stages.job: Spins fast using electricity to drive the whole machine.
Transfers the spinning motion over to the compressor wheel.
Uses a spinning crank and rod to push and pull.
Squeezes air tightly into the storage tank.

challenges.principle: The spinning motor turns a crank that pushes and pulls a piston back and forth. That up-and-down movement squeezes air into the storage tank.
